summary: Mobile responsiveness verification at 390x844 (iPhone 13) for admin + public pages. Measured document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth on each target route. All target pages pass no-horizontal-overflow requirement after a small CSS fix applied to /app/frontend/src/index.css (bib-grid columns changed to minmax(0, 1fr) to prevent grid children from overflowing the viewport). Desktop 1280px /admin regression: two-column layout intact (form left [57-387], table right [445-1247]).

ui_bugs.issue: Before fix: 2px horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth=392). Root cause: .bib-grid used grid-template-columns: 1fr which defaults to minmax(auto,1fr) — the flex bib-card children's intrinsic min-content (long name + big bib number) forced the track to expand beyond the 358px container width, producing a 376px card. Fixed by changing to minmax(0, 1fr) so tracks can shrink below intrinsic min-content. Verified: scrollWidth=390, card width=358.
